title: Smelling the Pressed Page  (轻嗅压干的书页)

segments.t: 在安静的九号房间里，泰莎和伊芙琳站在洒满阳光的玻璃窗旁，端详着那张三十年前沾了污渍的卡片和摊开的植物书。先完整听一遍她们的对话。
Tilt the smudged card slightly toward the afternoon sun, Tessa — do you see the first letter?
Two spoons of warm H... and then a round little sketch beside the ink blot!
That tiny round fruit with three pointed leaves is not a lemon — it is an orange!
Wait — warm H plus grated sweet orange peel! Could H stand for wildflower honey?!
Smell the paper right where the card rested for thirty years, my dear.
Close your eyes and breathe in: garden mint, sweet orange zest, and golden honey!
Of course! Warm honey stays soft and glossy without turning sour or rock hard!
And a pinch of grated orange peel brightens the summer berries without puckering Graham!
Look at the last unsmudged word at the corner: scatter toasted sliced almonds on top.
Two spoons of warm honey, grated orange zest, and toasted almond flakes!
Tin Three is still warm on the stove rack — go brush it right now, Chef!
Do not move from that piano bench, Evelyn; the real cake is five minutes away!
现在让我们逐句拆解这个藏在气味里的小小谜团。
Tilt the smudged card slightly toward the afternoon sun, Tessa — do you see the first letter?
“泰莎，把沾了墨渍的卡片稍微朝午后的阳光斜一斜——你看得见第一个字母吗？”伊芙琳指点着泰莎：
Tilt the smudged card slightly
tilt 是“倾斜”，加上副词 slightly（稍微）让动作显得更轻巧。
toward the afternoon sun,
不加 s 的 toward 在美式英语中占主导；英式英语更常拼作 towards。
Two spoons of warm H... and then a round little sketch beside the ink blot!
“两勺温热的 H……接着在墨水污渍旁边还有一个圆圆的小草图！”泰莎慢慢辨认着残存的字迹：
a round little sketch
sketch 是“简笔画、草图”；加上 little 带出一种小巧可爱的感觉。
beside the ink blot!
留意区分：beside 是“在……旁边”，而 besides 意思是“此外”。blot 指“墨水渍、污点”。
That tiny round fruit with three pointed leaves is not a lemon — it is an orange!
“那个带着三片尖叶子的圆圆小水果不是柠檬——是橙子！”伊芙琳一眼就认出了画里的水果：
three pointed leaves
leaves 是 leaf（叶子）的不规则复数，f 变为 v 再加 -es，和 knife 变 knives 一样。
it is an orange!
orange 以元音音素开头，所以前面用不定冠词 an；此外它也可以指“橙色”。
Wait — warm H plus grated sweet orange peel! Could H stand for wildflower honey?!
“等等——温热的 H 加上擦碎的甜橙皮！H 该不会代表野花蜂蜜吧！？”线索一串联，泰莎越说越激动：
grated sweet orange peel!
grated 意思是“擦碎的、磨碎的”；peel 作名词是“果皮”，作动词是“剥皮、削皮”。
Could H stand for wildflower honey?!
stand for 常用来解释缩写或首字母代表什么，比如 UK stands for United Kingdom。
Smell the paper right where the card rested for thirty years, my dear.
“亲爱的，闻闻这张纸，就闻卡片在上面压了三十年的那个位置。”伊芙琳温柔地提议用嗅觉来找答案：
Smell the paper
在这里 smell 是主动的及物动词，表示特意去“闻”某样东西。
rested for thirty years,
rest 是“放置、停歇”，for 引出持续的时间长度。my dear 是长辈常用的亲切称呼。
Close your eyes and breathe in: garden mint, sweet orange zest, and golden honey!
“闭上眼睛深吸一口气：园艺薄荷、甜橙皮屑，还有金黄色的蜂蜜！”注意 Close your eyes 里的物主代词：英语谈到身体部位时，习惯加上 your（你的）。
breathe in:
动词 breathe 读作 /briːð/，名词 breath 读作 /brɛθ/；加上 in 表示把空气吸进来。
sweet orange zest,
zest 专指柑橘类水果最外层富含香气的表皮（果皮屑）。
Of course! Warm honey stays soft and glossy without turning sour or rock hard!
“当然了！温热的蜂蜜能保持柔软发亮，既不会变酸，也不会硬得像石头！”伊芙琳一下子全明白了：
stays soft and glossy
stay + 形容词表示“保持某种状态”；glossy 形容像杂志封面那样水润发亮的光泽。
without turning sour or rock hard!
介词 without 后面的动词要变成 -ing 形式。rock hard 是在形容词 hard 前加上名词 rock（石头）来加强程度。
And a pinch of grated orange peel brightens the summer berries without puckering Graham!
“而且一撮擦碎的橙皮能提亮夏日浆果的风味，还不会酸得格雷厄姆皱起脸！”泰莎已经脑补出成品的滋味了：
a pinch of grated orange peel
a pinch of 指用两根手指捏起的分量，也就是“一撮、少许”。
brightens the summer berries
brighten 来自 bright（明亮的），意思是“使明快、提亮（风味）”；后缀 -en 可以把形容词变成动词，比如 soften。pucker 指吃酸东西时嘴唇皱起。
Look at the last unsmudged word at the corner: scatter toasted sliced almonds on top.
“看角落里最后一个没被抹脏的词：在表面撒上烤香的杏仁片。”卡片上还留着最后一条线索：
the last unsmudged word
前缀 un- 放在形容词前表示否定，就像 unhappy 或 unknown。
scatter toasted sliced almonds on top.
scatter 是随手“撒开、撒落”；on top 相当于“在表面、在上面”。
Two spoons of warm honey, grated orange zest, and toasted almond flakes!
“两勺温热的蜂蜜、擦碎的橙皮屑，还有烤杏仁片！”凑齐了完整配方，泰莎像念清单一样背了出来；注意 and 前面的逗号，这在美式英语列举中非常常见。
Two spoons of warm honey,
honey 读作 /ˈhʌni/，里面的字母 o 发音接近短元音 /ʌ/。
toasted almond flakes!
flakes 指薄片、碎屑，比如早餐玉米片就是 corn flakes。
Tin Three is still warm on the stove rack — go brush it right now, Chef!
“三号烤模在炉灶架上还温热着呢——大厨，现在就去刷上吧！”伊芙琳催促泰莎抓紧时间：
is still warm
still（仍然、还）通常放在 be 动词 is 后面，或者其他实义动词前面。
go brush it right now,
美式英语口语常说“go + 动词原形”，中间不加 and 或 to。brush 指用毛刷涂抹。
Do not move from that piano bench, Evelyn; the real cake is five minutes away!
“伊芙琳，别离开那张钢琴凳；真正的蛋糕五分钟就好！”临跑回厨房前，泰莎许下约定：
Do not move from that piano bench,
Do not + 动词原形构成否定祈使句，口语中常缩写为 don't。
five minutes away!
在时间或距离后面加上 away，表示“还有多远/还有多久”，例如 two miles away。下面请不受打扰地再完整听一遍对话。
Tilt the smudged card slightly toward the afternoon sun, Tessa — do you see the first letter?
Two spoons of warm H... and then a round little sketch beside the ink blot!
That tiny round fruit with three pointed leaves is not a lemon — it is an orange!
Wait — warm H plus grated sweet orange peel! Could H stand for wildflower honey?!
Smell the paper right where the card rested for thirty years, my dear.
Close your eyes and breathe in: garden mint, sweet orange zest, and golden honey!
Of course! Warm honey stays soft and glossy without turning sour or rock hard!
And a pinch of grated orange peel brightens the summer berries without puckering Graham!
Look at the last unsmudged word at the corner: scatter toasted sliced almonds on top.
Two spoons of warm honey, grated orange zest, and toasted almond flakes!
Tin Three is still warm on the stove rack — go brush it right now, Chef!
Do not move from that piano bench, Evelyn; the real cake is five minutes away!
午后的阳光和烘焙师敏锐的嗅觉，终于解开了三十年前的墨渍谜题：温热的蜂蜜、甜橙皮屑和烤杏仁片！保重，下次见！
Take care!
